newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria inflation down to 21.3 pct in year to June.
newsitem.headline: Algeria inflation down to 21.3 pct in year to June.

text.p: Algeria's inflation rate dropped to 21.3 percent for the year to June 1996 from 29.8 percent a year earlier, the Algerian Central Bank said on Tuesday.

"The (Algerian currency) dinar stability contributed to lowering the inflation, which reached 21.3 percent in year at the end of June 1996 against 29.8 percent in the same period in 1995," said a bank release carried by the official Algerian news agency APS.
The report covered the country's financial and monetary situation in the first half of the year compared with the same period in 1995.
